title: Me and the Prez, Drinking Under the Stars
titleEnglish: Me and the Prez, Drinking Under the Stars
synopsis: At 24, Reina Izutsu has recently become the new president of Izutsu Printing after taking over for her late father. Young and not quite experienced, Reina wants to do her best but unfortunately comes across as harsh with her employees. Stressed and feeling lost, Reina spends an evening drowning her sorrows in beer at an empty park. She rants and vents out loud to the starry sky that she wants to give up and quit being president, just letting off steam. Except, she fails to realize that her subordinate, 37-year-old section chief Kenichi Ishizumi, heard her drunken ramblings! But rather than use this against her, Kenichi finds himself charmed by the young woman. He vows then and there to support her and help her find her way as company president, no matter what! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

synopsis: Betrayed by his best friend, our protagonist loses everything: billions in wealth, his loved ones, and even his legs. In “Online Game: I Can Evolve Everything,” he gets a second chance at life. Reborn with a burning desire for vengeance, he vows to reclaim everything that was taken from him. When a revolutionary online game arrives, he finds himself at an advantage. No one understands this game better than he does! By getting into the game early and spending heavily, he can acquire a god-level skill known as "Evolve Everything." Now he prepares to exact his revenge. With his unmatched knowledge and newfound powers, he embarks on a journey to dominate the game and take back his rightful place in the world.

title: Zettai Karen Children
synopsis: In the future, as people with ESP increase in numbers, so does the possible good and evil they can cause to society. The Japanese government establishes of the Base of Backing ESP Laboratory (BABEL), a special esper organization tasked with dealing with situations that can't be resolved by ordinary means, including dealing with espers engaged in criminal activity. Prodigy Kouichi Minamoto is assigned by BABEL to the task of supervising the most powerful espers in the country, a trio of gifted but mischievous young girls known as "The Children". The Children and Minamoto must deal with several enemy organizations, each with conflicted views regarding the role of espers in the world, including "PANDRA", a cadre of rogue espers determined to wage war against the rest of mankind; "Black Phantom", a mercenary organization who brainwashes espers into living tools of destruction; and the "Normal People", composed solely of non-esper individuals who view espers only as a threat to be vanquished. (Source: Wikipedia) Included one-shot: Volume 1: Zettai Karen Children (pilot)
